commitments.detail: Release the toolkit under AGPL-3.0-only and provide corresponding source for the linked toolkit code as required by the AGPL-3.0 dependency.
Exclude the training corpus entirely from the public release package due to 37 customer support records containing personal data.
Exclude the benchmark package entirely from the public release due to customer-specific results whose disclosure is contractually prohibited.
Limit model weight downloads to users in the United States and Canada only and display an export-control notice on the repository.
